breakdown.summary: A 26 s vertical kinetic-typography spot at 60 fps: a voice-over argues that clarity beats loudness, and every spoken phrase gets its own typographic treatment on a pure white background with one accent green (#2bb51d). There are no camera shots - the whole piece is text and vector icons animated in post. The rhythm is set by the words: a new element lands on almost every phrase (95 effects/min), scenes are swapped with full-frame pushes, hidden cuts and fades rather than beat-synced cuts (only one of the scene changes lands on a beat).
breakdown.hook: f0-180 (00:00:00:00-00:00:03:00): the first word 'Attention' slams in at full width, motion-blurred, and shrinks into place by f12 (00:00:00:12) - the one loud move in a quiet video. The line completes to 'Attention is expensive' (green on the key word, soft glow, '$' particles) by f45 (00:00:00:45), then a hard cut at f79 (00:00:01:19) to the clock scene with the giant minute hand while the voice says 'because every second'. Nothing is said in the first second that the viewer has to read twice: one word, one idea.
structure: f0-78 (00:00:00:00-00:00:01:18) hook: 'Attention is expensive' - word scale-in + typewriter, green key word
f79-158 (00:00:01:19-00:00:02:38) clock scene: 'Because every second' - giant hand sweeping, green arc, fading title
f159-236 (00:00:02:39-00:00:03:56) audience scene (push down): 'Your audience spends' - people icon in a bracket frame, words fade in
f237-361 (00:00:03:57-00:00:06:01) understanding scene (push right): 'Trying to understand' typewriter, '???' outline, three testimonial cards pop in
f362-414 (00:00:06:02-00:00:06:54) counter scene (push up): a ring counting 3 > 17 with 'Is a second' typing - 'is a second of'
f415-673 (00:00:06:55-00:00:11:13) losses: three green hexagon icons pop in one by one - 'losing prospects / momentum / opportunities'
f674-832 (00:00:11:14-00:00:13:52) the turn: single green words swap per spoken word 'The brands leading the market.', then a serif italic 'Aren't louder.' types in and shrinks away

f833-1278 (00:00:13:53-00:00:21:18) the payoff grid: six pills slide in, one per phrase ('They're cleare.', 'Sharper', 'More intentional', 'They remove friction', 'They accelerate understanding', 'They make decisions feel effortless'), then fade to white

breakdown.captions: No burned-in captions in the usual sense - the typography IS the caption track. Every spoken phrase appears as its own text element, timed to the voice: single words centred (bold geometric sans, black, ~90 px at 1080 wide for the hook, ~50 px later), key words in green #2bb51d, emphasis words in an italic serif (green 'second' / 'spends', black 'Aren't louder.'). Typewriter lines run at 1.6-3 frames per character with the newest letter grey/blurred for one frame. Pills: rounded rectangles, green fill + white text or white fill + 2 px dark outline + black text, ~34 px text, one phrase each.
breakdown.text_graphics: Flat vector icon set in the same green: minute hand + arc with ticks (f79-158), five-person group icon with bracket corners (f159-236), three testimonial cards with avatar, 5 stars and 3-line quote (f305-351), progress ring counter (f362-414), hexagon icons with white line glyphs and black bracket corners + leader lines to labels (f421-673), two big blurred green rings as background texture (f830-1278), a hand-drawn green ellipse around the last claim (f1412-1451), a logo end card with a scramble/decode handle (f1470-1580). Small '$' particles and thin circle outlines decorate the hook.
breakdown.broll: None - no footage at all; cutaways are replaced by scene changes between typographic layouts (pushes at f153-165, f229-244, f355-367; cuts at f79, f833, f1470; fades at f407-414, f663-673, f1269-1278).
breakdown.sound: A calm English voice-over carries the whole piece (transcript lines at f0, f344, f676, f973, f1153); a quiet music bed at ~98 BPM underneath; no drops or builds detected, no obvious SFX on the hits. Everything is timed to the words, not the beat: only the 'It's leverage.' slide (f1403-1405) lands within a frame of a beat.
breakdown.cta: No spoken or written call to action; the end card f1470-1580 (00:00:24:30-00:00:26:20) shows the creator's logo and handle 'divyansh.fx_' (the decode animation makes the handle itself the CTA).

breakdown.camera: No camera. Every move is a 2D transform in post: scale-ins with directional blur (the hook word, the card and hexagon pop-ins from a dot), full-frame pushes between scenes, small drifts (the 'It's leverage.' group rises 1.5 % before the final cut). The whip pans and speed ramps the lab flagged (E018, E029, E039, E041) are all graphic moves.
breakdown.grade: Measured: brightness 96 %, saturation 5.5 %, contrast 37.7, main colour #fefdfe (93 %) - 'desaturated, bright, low contrast, lifted blacks'. That is the design, not a grade: a pure white background (#fefdfe, not off-white), true black text (#202321) and one saturated green (#2bb51d, ~1 % of pixels) that reads as the only colour. The measured 'lifted blacks' comes from how little black there is per frame, not from a lifted curve - keep text at full black when rebuilding. The green glow and the blurred rings are the only soft elements; everything else is crisp vector.
breakdown.rhythm: 13.7 scene changes/min, median shot 1.35 s, but the real pace is one new element per spoken phrase (~95 per min): a word or pill lands every 0.4-1.2 s during speech and holds 0.5-1.9 s between phrases. Only 1 of the ~10 scene changes is on a beat (f1403-1405); the music is a bed, the voice is the clock. Entrances are fast (4-12 frames) with ease-out, exits are a bit slower (8-16 frames) with ease-in, holds are long - the 'slam in, rest, slip out' pattern.
rebuild_tips: Write the voice-over first and cut the audio; mark the start frame of every phrase - each becomes one text element that lands within 3-6 frames of the word (this video types or slides each phrase in as it is said).
Pick one background (pure white), one text colour (true black) and ONE accent (here green #2bb51d) and use the accent only on the key word of each line and on the icons; no gradients, no shadows.

Three entrance recipes cover the whole video: (a) scale-in from huge or from a dot with directional blur and ease-out (hook word f5-26, cards f305-328, hexagons f421-433), (b) typewriter at 2-3 frames per character with the newest letter blurred one frame (f250-281, f778-798, f1279-1382), (c) horizontal slide with leading-edge motion blur, ease-out (pills f833-1184).

Change scenes with full-frame pushes (12-16 frames, S-curve, blur on the move: f153-165 down, f229-244 right, f355-367 up) or a 10-frame fade to white, and hide at most two hard cuts under a new element popping in.
Give every layout a 0.5-2 s hold after its last element lands (this is what the lab called 'freeze frames'); the pause is part of the pacing, do not fill it.
Finish with the final claim slid in and circled by a hand-drawn stroke (f1405-1451), then a 1.8 s end card with the logo and a scramble-decode handle (f1470-1580) and a 7-frame fade to white.

(green, E029) f833-837; 'Sharper' (outline) from the right f871-874; 'More intentional' (outline) from the left f915-932 (00:00:15:15-00:00:15:32); 'They remove friction' (green) from the right f968-993 (00:00:16:08-00:00:16:33); 'They accelerate understanding' (green) from the left f1045-1069 (00:00:17:25-00:00:18:09); 'They make decisions feel effortless' (outline) from the right f1142-1184 (00:00:19:02-00:00:19:44). Hold f1185-1270 (00:00:19:45-00:00:21:10); the whole grid fades to white f1271-1278 (E037). The big soft rings drift slowly throughout. Later slides are longer (25-42 frames) than the first ones (4-17).
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat -15.5 frames from the key frame)
effects.rebuild: Six pill groups (Rectangle corner radius = half height; green fill #2bb51d with white text, or white fill with 2 px dark outline and black text; ~34 px sans). Each: Transform X from off-screen (+/- 1.2 frame widths) to its grid slot over the frames above, ease-out; Directional Blur horizontal keyed from ~40 px to 0 over the first half of each move. Rows at y ~37 %, 40 %, 43 %, 46 % of the frame height. Rings: two Ellipse masks with 80 px blur, 15 % green, slow Transform drift.
